title: Ermittlungen wegen des Verdachts des versuchten Mordes - Mordkommission sucht Zeugen

extraction.summaryEn: Unknown persons threw an e-scooter from the Hermann-Ganswindt-Brücke onto the BAB 100 motorway, narrowly missing a driver. Homicide investigators are treating it as an attempted killing and appealing for witnesses and dash-cam footage.
